question: After removing inverse-root and geometry-refit changes, does the physical tensor point consistently toward lower held-out image residuals?
interpretation: first-order observed-image response diagnostic on spent systems; not a predictive formula score

baseline_fit.rule: fit zero-field geometry on training images; hold its six geometry parameters fixed over the entire response grid

response_grid.source_rule: reprofile source positions from training images at each t; apply those sources unchanged to held-out images
response_grid.metric: Jacobian-mapped local image-plane RMS at the observed positions; no inverse lens root is requested

claim_limits: The statistic is a local observed-image response and is not an exact inverse-lens prediction.
All systems and the response range are spent; this is not independent validation.
Holding lens geometry fixed isolates tensor direction but omits legitimate joint-parameter covariance.
Agreement across two optimizer seed ensembles is a stability diagnostic, not a population test.
No formula can be promoted from P0562.
